notes: Tuition: the programme page does not state a tuition fee. The institution-wide Studiekosten page gives one institutional fee (instellingscollegegeld) of EUR 10,308 for 2026-2027 for voltijd, which applies to non-EU/EEA students who do not meet the conditions for the statutory fee; used per TASK allowance. Intake: deadline 1 May for non-EEA students, year 2026 taken from the quoted academic year 2026-2027.
